scope: Same-researcher content reading of the three changed stored cases, after purposev5 passed 344 existing/new tests. This is a regression finding, not an independent quality rating.
rejected_change: Promoting only root uses and their exact actions removed known linked episodes from the default explanation even though expanded material accounts remained valid.

findings.reason: The displayed later rook attack on the bishop on a7 must retain that bishop's preceding Bxa7 gain from the rook's former support duty.
The knight that actually uses the vacated e4 square is subsequently captured on e4. Displaying the use while moving that loss to detail hides its known price.
The selected Bxh7+ / Kxh7 support use depends on the earlier e4 clearance and its observed exchange. The existing check episode also includes Qd3+ / Kg8.

decision: Keep an existing bundle's capture/check episode, including its connected conditions and replies, until a narrower account is independently closed. Do not count uncertain importance as successful omission. Plain background geometry may still move to detail when it carries no such episode.
